name: Caixa Seguridade Participacoes S.A.
summary: Caixa Seguridade Participações S.A. provides various life and non-life insurance policies in Brazil. It offers housing, elementary, credit, and auto insurance; and private retirement plans, capitalization bonds, and consortium. The company was incorporated in 2015 and is based in Brasília, Brazil. Caixa Seguridade Participações S.A. is a subsidiary of Caixa Econômica Federal.
